alt_text: Slide 1 of 6. Regret can point to a lesson without becoming your permanent address.
Slide 2 of 6. Replaying the same moment may feel like taking responsibility, even when it no longer produces new information.
Slide 3 of 6. Write the lesson in practical language: what would I choose differently in a similar situation?
Slide 4 of 6. Consider whether a safe, appropriate repair is possible. Do not force contact or an apology conversation on someone else.
Slide 5 of 6. When the issue needs professional support, seek it. You do not have to keep examining it alone.
Slide 6 of 6. Send this to someone who wants to learn without living inside the same moment forever.
